Baseline coverage matrix for current HolSmt parser, HOL-to-SMT-LIB translator, solver entry points, and Z3 proof replay. This is not a completeness claim.

Current coverage records the implementation state observed in source and executable tests. COMPLETE-required coverage records the stricter target: rows are `reconstructed` only when real complete evidence exists, `red` while implementation obligations remain, and `not_applicable` only with an explicit scope reason.

## COMPLETE Status Conventions

D12 resource-gated cases retain the existing `reconstructed`, `red`, and `not_applicable` COMPLETE statuses. Their case IDs are enumerated separately in the Resource-gated IDs column on matching FloatingPoint rows: a gate is checked evidence of the fixed resource boundary, not an implementation obligation and never a red row. This is the smallest honest representation because no fourth row status is needed.

## Status Legend

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| implemented | Implemented in current source for the stated surface. |
| parse only | Parsed or normalized intentionally, with no replay step for this surface. |
| unsupported diagnostic | Rejected or unavailable through an explicit diagnostic rather than silently accepted. |
| untested | Implementation may exist, but no current checked coverage is identified here. |
| unknown | Coverage has not been established. |
| not applicable | The column does not apply to this row. |
